title: Covert Action in Chile: 1963–1973 (Staff Report of the Select Committee to Study Governmental Operations with Respect to Intelligence Activities)
authors: Select Committee on Intelligence, United States Senate (Church Committee)
summary: Authoritative United States congressional inquiry uncovering millions of dollars in covert CIA spending directed by the Nixon-Kissinger 40 Committee to manipulate Chilean elections, orchestrate economic warfare, finance anti-government media (El Mercurio) and transport strikes, and establish contact with Chilean military conspirators prior to the 1973 coup.
